Welcome to the Aurorian!

This mirror serves as a guide for those who want to progress in the mod. No entry is hidden, and this mirror saves no data!

Somewhat like an in-game wiki! :)







§9thank u for playing! <3 - Elise(Shiroroku)
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.auroriani: Aurorianite tools can mainly be found in the §9Runestone§r §9Dungeon§r.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.dungeon_d: The Darkstone Armory is an underground maze-like storage for the Moon Queen's army.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.dungeon_m:
The Moon Temple floats in the sky, always on the X and Z axis. A path leads up to its entrance, home of The Moon Queen!

Around it float islands with Moongems, and its interior has two towers each holding a Moon Temple Cell Key Fragment.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.crystalli: Crystalline gear and tools are found in the Moon Temple's chests, the reward for clearing its halls.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.dungeon_r:
The Runestone Dungeon is a cylindrical tower, with each floor containing loot and enemies.

This dungeons warden is the §9Dungeon§r §9Keeper§r, an undead servant of the Moon Queen who is adept at archery, as well as swordfighting.



§9Maybe consider bringing a shield? Oh and a Scrapper!§r
The Aurorian has a dungeon progression system, meaning you must complete one dungeon to unlock another.

Dungeon Walls are unbreakable! (At least until you beat them all) And each one has a unique boss with unique loot.

You can find more information for each dungeon in the next entries!



§9The Runestone Dungeon is the first, craft some Lockpicks to pick the door!
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.ores.desc:
New ores, of course!

Under the soil of The Aurorian you can find §9Cerulean§r, §9Moonstone§r, and rarely §9Geodes§r.

Each have their own particular uses which you can learn more about in the next entries.

mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.agricultu:
Lavender and Silkberry grow in the wild, and drop seeds you can plant in a farm!

Plant them on Aurorian Farm Tiles like normal crops. Lavender makes tea and bread, while Silkberry makes jam, sandwiches and tea. Bright Bulbs make an especially potent brew...
The Aurorian is home to Aurorian Pigs, Rabbits and Sheep! They behave like their overworld cousins, but with a blue tint.

You will also find Dungeon Slimes bouncing through the caverns, and strange glowing Mushrooms deep underground.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.boss_loot:
Every dungeon boss drops a Trophy. Bring it to the Moonlight Forge together with the right item to craft powerful equipment, like the Keeper’s Bow or the Queen’s Chipper!

Dungeon chests also hold unique gear: Umbra weapons from the Darkstone Armory, and Crystalline tools from the Moon Temple.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.locator.d:
Lost? The Dungeon Locator points the way!

Sneak right-click to cycle which dungeon to locate, then right-click to face the nearest one.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.aurorian_:
Aurorian Steel is the ultimate alloy of the Aurorian.

Combine Aurorianite, Umbra, and Crystalline materials at the Moonlight Forge to create it. Tools and armor made from Aurorian Steel gain XP as you use them, and will eventually upgrade their enchantments on their own!
Start with a Silentwood Crafting Table, then build the Aurorian Furnace (and optional Chimney stacks for fuel efficiency), the Moonlight Forge, and the Scrapper.

The Moonlight Forge works only under open moonlight. The Scrapper breaks dungeon loot down into scraps you can reforge into ingots.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.ore_cerul:
Cerulean Ore is common under Aurorian soil.

Smelt it into ingots for mid-tier armor and shields. Cerulean arrows and nuggets are useful utility items throughout progression.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.ore_moons:
Moonstone Ore is common underground.

Moonstone tools waste less durability at night and more during the day. They are a solid step up from Aurorian Stone gear before you dive into dungeons.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.ore_geode:
Geodes are rare crystal clusters found underground.

Break them for Crystal, used in machines, arrows, and several magical recipes.
mirror_of_guidance.theaurorian.umbra.des:
Umbra gear is the reward of the Darkstone Armory.

Look for Umbra tools and weapons in Darkstone chests. The Umbra Pickaxe can lock onto a single block type, and Umbra defenses trade mobility for durability.

modifier.theaurorian.moonlit.description: In the Aurorian dimension or at night, has a chance to negate tool and armor durability damage entirely. In daylight, has a chance to deal extra damage.
The aurorian light fuels your swing.
Mining speed is increased while inside the Aurorian dimension.
